died.name: Maximilian I of Mexico
died.cause: after being shot by firing squad

died.name: Charles Hodge
died.last_words: My work is done. The pins of the tabernacle are taken out.

died.name: Alan Stacey
died.cause: The 26-year-old British racing driver died in a crash during the 1960 Belgian Grand Prix when a bird struck him in the face. Twenty-two-year-old British driver Chris Bristow was killed during the same race, five laps before Stacey and on the same extended fast right-hand bend.

died.name: Vincent Chin
died.cause: just after being beaten with a baseball bat by Chrysler plant supervisor Ronald Ebens. Chin died four days later at Henry Ford Hospital

born.name: Baron Johann de Kalb
born.desc: officer in the American War of Independence
born.cause: speaking to a British officer after being mortally wounded and captured at the Battle of Camden
born.last_words: I thank you, sir, for your generous sympathy, but I die the death I always prayed for, the death of a soldier fighting for the rights of man.

born.name: Richard Monckton Milnes, 1st Baron Houghton
born.last_words: My exit is the result of too many entrées.

born.name: Elbert Hubbard
born.cause: prior to dying with his wife in the sinking of the RMS Lusitania
born.last_words: Well, they [German Empire] have got us. They are a damn sight worse than I ever thought they were.

born.name: José Rizal
born.cause: quoting Jesus prior to execution by firing squad for rebellion, sedition and conspiracy
